about_the_game:
A LATE-NIGHT SNACK TURNS INTO A NIGHTMARE

On your way to get a snack from the grocery store, you realize the place is far more spacious than you remember... and when you look back, the door has vanished.

You are not alone in there, and the exit is yet to be found. Investigate alone or with up to 8 companions to explore, survive, and defend yourself from the monstrosities guarding this deformed, yet delicious dimension.

SURVIVE STARVATION

Gather a wide variety of typical grocery provisions to sustain yourself until you escape, and stock up on any other useful resources. Will you let hunger consume you before the monsters do?

BUILD YOUR SHELTER BEFORE NIGHTFALL

Once the grocery closes, the monstrous employees clock in. The night shift begins. Use everything you can find to set up fortifications and live through the night... but they won’t give you a moment of safety. Defend yourself from various abominations by building a base to your taste.

A NEVER-ENDING LIMINAL TORMENT

This dimension won’t let you off the hook that easily. Its layout changes constantly, so you'll always need to adapt your strategy. Complete objectives to grow stronger and turn the tables on your enemies. Make your way through each level, hoping to finally escape this place.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER

With an empty store, who's going to stop you from helping yourself? Sounds like free stuff to me! Every piece of clothing you escape with gets added to your wardrobe, giving you tons of customization options.

WISHLIST TO SUPPORT

The game is still in development, but we have plenty we want to offer. To support the project and help us reach a wider audience, you can add the game to your Steam wishlist.

This means a lot to us.

DEMO?

To give you a chance to try an early version of the game, we have a demo planned for release in the coming months. Follow Arcadia's Creations on all platforms to get the latest news about GROSSERIES and future games.

  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or equivalent
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card with the latest drivers.
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card with the latest drivers.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

Investigate with up to 8 friends to explore, survive, and defend yourself from monstrosities guarding this deformed dimension. Will you let hunger consume you before the monsters do?
